instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.description: From the specified USGS event executive page, record (a) the event title exactly as shown and (b) the displayed coordinates exactly as shown. Full credit for correct title and coordinate pair as displayed on the executive page. If the page or the relevant executive display is inaccessible/blocked/fails to load, award full credit if the agent clearly states this limitation and indicates it attempted to retrieve the title/coordinates from the executive page. Partial credit if only one of the two (title or coordinates) is reported, or if formatting differs but values are clearly the same.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the executive-page header with title “M 9.1 - 2011 Great Tohoku Earthquake, Japan” and the metadata row including coordinates “38.297°N 142.373°E”. This is the relevant (and only clearly readable) evidence for title/coordinates.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s reported title and displayed coordinates match what is visible in the screenshot. Minor formatting nitpicks mentioned in the baseline (spacing) do not change the substance of the title/coordinates as displayed.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program event executive page header with the event title text: “M 9.1 - 2011 Great Tohoku Earthquake, Japan”. Directly beneath the title line, the metadata row shows “2011-03-11 05:46:24 (UTC) | 38.297°N 142.373°E | 29.0 km depth”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot directly supports the agent’s reported event title and coordinates. The title and the coordinate pair (38.297°N 142.373°E) match what is visibly displayed on the executive page, so this criterion is fully satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy for this criterion: the agent’s title and coordinates align with the visible title and coordinate text in the screenshot.

criteria.criterion: Intensity: Did You Feel It? (community MMI)
criteria.description: Report the MMI shown in the 'Did You Feel It?' executive card (community intensity) and keep it distinct from ShakeMap. Full credit for the exact MMI value as displayed. If the DYFI executive card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that it cannot access the DYFI MMI on the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if an intensity is reported but DYFI attribution is unclear.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 includes a “Did You Feel It?” card but the community MMI value is not legible; Screenshot 2 does not show the DYFI card at all. Thus, no screenshot evidence confirms the DYFI MMI value.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Because the DYFI community intensity value is not readable/verified in the provided screenshots, the agent’s specific claim (“IX MMI”) is unsupported by evidence and should not receive full credit. However, the agent did keep DYFI distinct from ShakeMap, so minimal partial credit is appropriate.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: On the right side of the executive cards row, a card labeled “Did You Feel It?” is visible. Inside that card is a small intensity map graphic. However, no clearly readable numeric/roman-numeral MMI value is visible in the screenshot for the DYFI card (the map legend text is too small to read and there is no prominent large MMI numeral shown).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot does not provide readable evidence of the DYFI community MMI value (e.g., a visible “IX” label). The agent’s predicted output states “IX MMI,” but that specific MMI value is not legible/confirmable from the provided screenshot alone. Therefore, based strictly on this screenshot, the agent’s DYFI MMI claim is unsupported.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent claimed “Did You Feel It? (community intensity): IX MMI,” but the screenshot’s DYFI card does not show a clearly readable IX (or any other explicit MMI numeral) that can be verified from the pixels provided.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: In the visible executive-card grid, cards shown include “ShakeMap”, “Ground Failure”, “Origin”, “Moment Tensor”, “Finite Fault”, “View Nearby Seismicity”, and “Contributors (USGS)”. There is no “Did You Feel It?” executive card visible anywhere in this screenshot, and no DYFI MMI value is shown.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the DYFI executive card and its community intensity value are not visible in the provided screenshot, the screenshot cannot confirm the agent’s reported “Did You Feel It? (community intensity): IX MMI.” The agent did not state inability to access DYFI; they provided a specific value, which is unsupported by this screenshot evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output claims DYFI community intensity is “IX MMI,” but the screenshot does not display a “Did You Feel It?” card or any DYFI MMI value to verify that claim.

criteria.criterion: Ground Failure: Landslide Estimate (area and population exposure wording)
criteria.description: From the 'Ground Failure' executive card, record the Landslide Estimate area statement and the population exposure wording as shown, paired correctly with the Landslide estimate (not liquefaction). Full credit for both area and population exposure wording correctly captured and attributed. If the Ground Failure card/landslide section is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the landslide estimate text from the executive card despite attempting to. Partial credit if only area or only population exposure is captured, or wording is lightly paraphrased but meaning is preserved.

criteria.criterion: Origin card fields (review status, magnitude/type, depth, time, contributor)
criteria.description: From the labeled 'Origin' executive card (not the narrative summary), report: Review Status, Magnitude including its type, Depth, Time, and the displayed contributor. Full credit for all five fields accurately captured as displayed. If the Origin card is missing or fails to load due to external page issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot access the Origin card fields despite attempting to. Partial credit if one or two fields are missing/mislabeled but the rest are correct.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows the “Origin” executive card with: Review Status “REVIEWED”, Magnitude “9.1 mww”, Depth “29.0 km”, Time “2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC”, and the contributor line displayed as “Contributed by US US”.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Review Status, Magnitude value/type (“9.1 mww”), Depth, and Time match the screenshot. The agent’s contributor entry is not exact (they wrote only “US” vs the on-card display “US US”), so deduct for that missing display detail while giving strong partial credit for the other correctly reported fields.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence:
The “Origin” executive card is visible. It shows:
- “Review Status” with value “REVIEWED”
- “Magnitude” with value “9.1 mww”
- “Depth” with value “29.0 km”
- “Time” with value “2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC”
At the bottom of the card it shows “Contributed by US US” (with the “US” appearing twice).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Review Status, Magnitude/type, Depth, and Time all match the agent’s predicted output. However, the contributor line in the screenshot reads “Contributed by US US,” while the agent reported only “US.” That makes the contributor field not captured exactly as displayed, so this should be treated as partial rather than full credit for the Origin fields.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output lists displayed contributor as “US,” but the Origin card in the screenshot shows “Contributed by US US” (duplicate “US”). Other Origin fields align with the screenshot.

  - Time: "2011-03-11 05:46:24 UTC"
  - Contributor line rendered as: "Contributed by US US".

dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Agent correctly reported Review Status, Magnitude with type, Depth, and Time exactly as shown. However, for the requested "displayed contributor," the DOM explicitly displays "Contributed by US US" (duplicated), while the agent output simplifies this to "US". Since the task asks for the displayed contributor from the Origin card, this is a minor-but-real transcription mismatch on one of five required fields, so award strong partial credit rather than full.
